Paper: CMI-RewardBench: Evaluating Music Reward Models with Compositional Multimodal Instruction
Dataset: 110k pseudo-preference pairs; 797 h generated audio; 4,027 human preference labels; outputs from 23 generation models

Paper: FoleyBench: A Benchmark For Video-to-Audio Models
Dataset_public: Yes, gated; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; academic research.
Dataset: 5,000 video-audio-text triplets (~10 s each, ~13 GB); FoleyBench-Long adds 650 30-second videos.

Paper: Jamendo-MT-QA: A Benchmark for Multi-Track Comparative Music Question Answering
Dataset_public: Creative-Commons Jamendo-derived benchmark; release terms/source track availability must be respected
Dataset: 36,519 QA items over 12,173 Creative-Commons Jamendo track pairs; three question forms per pair. LLM-assisted generation/filtering uses music descriptions/captions and human/LLM validation.

Paper: Muse: Towards Reproducible Long-Form Song Generation with Fine-Grained Style Control
Dataset: 116k fully licensed synthetic songs, 2–6 minutes, generated with SunoV5 and annotated with structured lyrics/style

Paper: TMD-Bench: Multi-Level Evaluation for Music–Dance Co-Generation
CMI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Music Instruction Following
Dataset_public: Yes for benchmark assembly; underlying source-dataset licenses differ
Dataset: 14 MIR instruction tasks derived from 20 public source datasets; Hugging Face benchmark is test-only and ~57.7GB. Tasks include key, tagging, instrument, pitch, beat/downbeat, melody, technique, lyrics and affect.

Paper: MuseControlLite: Multifunctional Music Generation with Lightweight Conditioners
Dataset: Uses Stable Audio Open training/evaluation resources plus task-specific conditions

Paper: WildScore: Benchmarking MLLMs in-the-Wild Symbolic Music Reasoning
Dataset: Wild score images/questions sourced from real-world material (including Reddit); exact split in paper

Paper: MuChin: A Chinese Colloquial Description Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models in the Field of Music
Dataset: CaiMD plus 1,000 high-quality benchmark entries; multi-person multi-stage annotation platform.
